identity.name: Watercolor Brush
identity.author: Paper Studio
identity.licence: Proprietary — Paper Studio internal pilot; includes OFL 1.1 fonts under their own licences; third-party notices in LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.txt
lineage: Lemo-Opuscar watercolor STYLE.md/DEMO.md (read-only source grammar; no code or media copied)

adaptation.aspects: Compose the 1:1 journal page for a locked sheet. The 16:9 scroll is one continuous lateral walk; never stretch a 1:1 page. The 9:16 vertical page is a different composition, not a crop of the scroll.
adaptation.type: Cormorant Garamond italic for titles and subtitles, Cormorant regular for body, Caveat for hand notes, IBM Plex Mono for measured labels. No fourth family.
adaptation.photographs: None. The style paints its subjects. A client photograph may be reference for a painted portrait, never pasted into a frame.
adaptation.captions: Sixteen words maximum per content slot, two lines maximum, fourteen pixels minimum at 390 px width.
adaptation.scripts: Latin script only. A non-Latin commission needs a licensed companion face, not a silent fallback.
adaptation.sound: The style supplies no audio files. Music and voice are cleared per film; delivery loudness belongs to the format.

assets.grammar: One sheet of warm cotton paper; transparent washes; painted forms built from individual strokes; a hand annotation layer; no vector outline, no photograph, no gloss, no cast shadow.

rigs.reason: No on-camera cast; painted plants and objects are props, not rigged characters.

sources.take: paper as the white, transparent layering, flying white, painting-in, one annotation layer, one accent, a long lateral camera walk
sources.notTake: the Follow the Rain story, the Australian rainfall journey, the map, the specific plants and animals, the 113.6 s timing, the LemoLab end card
sources.rights: Lemo-Opuscar watercolor STYLE.md/DEMO.md: MIT docs, Copyright (c) 2026 LemoLab; demo film CC BY 4.0 LemoLab. Observed and rewritten; no code, stills, music or voice copied.

sources.take: specimen plus note, generous paper margins, one hero subject per view, a measured label
sources.notTake: a specific botanical plate, artwork, character or layout
sources.rights: public-domain naturalist field journals and botanical plates, described and observed only; no image reproduced.

sources.take: one continuous painted world read laterally; the camera move is the argument
sources.notTake: a specific handscroll, its narrative, its figures or its sequence
sources.rights: public-domain handscroll panoramas, described and observed only; no image reproduced.

sources.take: wet-on-dry transparent layering, pooled edges, dry-brush flying white, paper as the white, no opaque flat fill
sources.notTake: ink wash, impasto, gouache opacity, a vector illustration with a watercolour texture laid on top
sources.rights: public-domain watercolour manuals and public reference, observed only; no text or image reproduced.

governance.review: The director opens card.html at 900 x 700 and on a 390 px phone, checks the title, specimen and close, answers the paint-in choice, then signs.
questions: How loose is the brush? The style fixes a loaded round brush and a rigger; the looseness is in the stroke, not in a pencil sketch.
Is a hand note always present? One note per view, with a leader line; the note never covers the subject.
Does the style allow a photograph? No. A photograph may be reference for a painting, never a pasted layer.

choices.question: Paint-in speed: 1.2 s or 1.8 s per specimen?

decisions.answer: Lemo-Opuscar watercolor is the source grammar; the pack text is written for Paper Studio.
decisions.reason: The source is MIT docs and a CC BY 4.0 demo; the demo story, code and media are not reusable as a product style.

decisions.answer: No Follow the Rain story, characters, map, plants, animals, timings, music, voice or end card.
decisions.reason: The demo is one example among many; the style must carry a different film.

decisions.answer: paper, ink, wash, petal, accent, deep; at most five pigments per frame; deep is wash at more passes.
decisions.reason: The source says darker comes from more passes, not a darker pigment. Six role names keep the palette legible; five pigments keep a frame watercolour.

decisions.answer: Cormorant Garamond italic/regular, Caveat, IBM Plex Mono. Latin only in this pilot.
decisions.reason: The source's type roles are a serif, a hand and a mono. The OFL trio is bundled and reproducible; non-Latin scripts need a licensed companion face.

decisions.answer: wipe, page_turn, hold. No cut, no dissolve.
decisions.reason: The source cuts rarely and uses brush-edge wipes, a new sheet and mist; a smaller set is easier to reproduce.

decisions.answer: 1:1 locked page, eight shots; 16:9 continuous walk, four shots; 9:16 blind page, six shots.
decisions.reason: A page is locked; a handscroll is one walk. Repeating the same eight-shot montage at two aspects would not prove two formats.

decisions.answer: No photographic likeness and no on-camera cast. A photo may be reference for a painting.
decisions.reason: Paper-as-white and painted forms cannot survive a pasted photograph. Photo-led weddings stay with paper-vows.

decisions.answer: No gallery.json in the pack in S1b.
decisions.reason: It is not validated by the S1a contract, would enter packHash, and serves the Phase 4 app.

decisions.answer: The 11-section STYLE.md is proven in this pack; styles/_template is unchanged.
decisions.reason: A template change needs its own scaffold smoke test and would change every pack's templateHash. Prove it once first.
